final_candidates.decision_summary: Highest EVEscape score (0.810) among all tested candidates with good structure compatibility (0.617) and high B-factor (41.07) confirming surface exposure consistent with antibody contact in the m102.4 epitope region.

Solid escape score (0.618) combined with the best structure compatibility in the batch (0.792); the conservative aromatic substitution preserves local packing while altering the antibody epitope surface.

Outstanding structure compatibility (0.936) ensures protein viability and receptor-binding preservation; moderate escape score (0.552) is acceptable given the strong structural support and confirmed surface exposure.

stop_reason.detail: Top-3 candidates are well-differentiated with complementary evidence from both phenotype and structure tools; further evidence gathering is unlikely to alter the ranking.

history.rationale: E501 is in the receptor-binding head domain near the m102.4 epitope region; charge reversal may disrupt antibody contacts while potentially preserving ephrin-B2 interactions if not directly at the receptor interface.
